description: Registry of recurring research series tracked by /autoresearch. Before gap-driven discovery, the agent sweeps every series whose nextExpected date has passed (or is null) and searches for the newest edition. After each sweep the agent updates lastChecked; after each ingestion it updates lastIngested and recomputes nextExpected from the cadence. lastChecked: null means the series has never been swept. All dates are YYYY-MM-DD.
